name: NASDAQ-100 vs S&P 500 Quarterly Start Comparison
description: Historical comparison of NASDAQ-100 and S&P 500 returns by quarterly start month for lump-sum and monthly investing horizons.

investment_modes.label: Lump-Sum Investing
investment_modes.description: Invest the full amount at the start month and hold for the selected horizon.

investment_modes.label: Monthly Investing
investment_modes.description: Invest the same amount every month from the start month through the month before the end date.

return_types.label: Total Return
return_types.description: Total-return index data, including dividends where source data is available.

field_definitions.nasdaq100: NASDAQ-100 return percentage for the row.
field_definitions.sp500: S&P 500 return percentage for the row.

caveats: Historical comparison only; not investment advice.
Taxes, fees, foreign exchange effects, and transaction costs are excluded.
Total-return coverage differs by source; read /api/source-notes.json before using total-return data.

endpoints.description: Chart-ready comparison rows grouped by return type, investment mode, and holding period.
